title: MSM Unify: Global Education Platform - CA
description: MSM Unify is a global education technology platform that helps students find and apply to international universities and programs. It connects students with 1,500+ campuses and more than 50,000 programs across destinations such as Canada, the USA, the UK, Australia, and Germany. The platform provides support with course selection, university applications, scholarships, visa assistance, education loans, accommodation, and test preparation
